What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: Your 2026-09-17 ask, the measurement half: the property lane gets the duration row and verdict the unit lane has had since BL-078/BL-378. FIRM: observation only - the recorder never changes which files run, their order, the timeout or the exit status; a killed run leaves no row. FIRM: no budg…
